subject: Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension (VARC)
source_note: Compiled from CAT 2025 (conducted 30 Nov 2025 by IIM Kozhikode) slot-wise analyses and multi-year coaching-tracker trend data, cross-checked Sep 2026. CAT has no officially published 'syllabus document' the way NEET/JEE do - IIM releases only a broad exam pattern notification - so topic lists here are reverse-engineered from repeated question-type patterns across the last several years' papers. Always cross-check against the current-year CAT official notification/mock test for the exact question mix, since IIMs occasionally rebalance the RC:VA ratio or question count without prior notice.
exam_pattern_note: CAT VARC: 24 questions, 40-minute fixed time limit (non-transferable from/to other sections), no sectional choice. Roughly 4 RC passages of ~4-5 questions each (~16 questions) plus ~8 Verbal Ability questions. Most RC questions are single-correct MCQ (4-5 options); Verbal Ability questions (para jumbles, para summary, odd sentence out, para completion) are a mix of TITA (type-in-the-answer, no options given) and MCQ, varying by slot/year.

subtopics: Long-passage RC (~500-700 words) on argumentative/analytical themes (economics, philosophy, science, sociology, history)
Author's tone, purpose and central-idea questions
Vocabulary-in-context and word-usage questions embedded in passages
topics.note: Typically 4 passages x 4 questions = 16 questions; by far the largest chunk of VARC.

subtopics: Re-ordering 4-5 jumbled sentences into a coherent paragraph
topics.question_format: TITA (type the correct sequence) in most recent years

subtopics: Selecting/typing the option that best captures a paragraph's central idea
topics.question_format: Mix of MCQ and TITA across recent years

topics.area: Odd Sentence Out / Para Completion / Para Insertion
subtopics: Odd sentence out: identifying the sentence that disrupts a paragraph's logical flow
Para completion: selecting/typing the sentence that best completes a paragraph
Para insertion: identifying where a given sentence best fits within a paragraph
topics.question_format: Mix of MCQ and TITA; exact sub-type mix varies by year
topics.note: ~2-4 questions typically; one or two of these sub-types appear per year, not all three together.
